daysBack.title: Days back
daysBack.description: Recency window in days. 0 = today only.

spreadsheetId.title: Google Spreadsheet ID
spreadsheetId.description: Spreadsheet containing the Input and Output sheets.

inputSheet.title: Input sheet name
inputSheet.description: Columns: A = KOL_ID, B = KOL_Name, C = Suffix (roster credentials, e.g. "MD, FAAN" — powers suffix-match/conflict in the identity gate), D = Affiliation (optional; triggers anchored precision mode), E = Specialty (optional; feeds the identity gate).

serviceAccountJson.title: Google service-account JSON (secret)
serviceAccountJson.description: Full service-account JSON. Alternatively set the GOOGLE_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_JSON environment variable on the actor. Never commit this file to the repo or the Docker image.

kolConcurrency.title: KOL concurrency
kolConcurrency.description: How many KOLs to process in parallel. 3-5 recommended for weekly fleet-scale runs; safe because staging-tab writes are atomic appends.

maxFailureRatePct.title: Max KOL failure rate (%)
maxFailureRatePct.description: If more than this percentage of KOLs fail, the run is marked FAILED after promoting its results, so schedule monitoring alerts. No-silent-degradation gate.

useApifyProxy.title: Use Apify proxy for page crawls
useApifyProxy.description: Routes article-page requests through Apify proxy. Recommended if many news sites block datacenter IPs.

crawlSocialPlatforms.title: Attempt to crawl social platforms
crawlSocialPlatforms.description: LinkedIn/X/Instagram/etc. almost always block plain HTTP crawls; when false (default) their SERP metadata is used as-is and no crawl is attempted.

includeSocialResults.title: Include social-platform results
includeSocialResults.description: When false, Facebook/Instagram/X/LinkedIn/YouTube/TikTok results are dropped from the output. Live testing showed social floods name queries with wrong-person posts (74% of rows in the pilot run); turn off for press-article deliverables.

identityGate.title: Identity gate
enumTitles: Drop REVIEW rows (only VALID reach Output)
identityGate.description: Requires each result to prove it is about this KOL: strong name form, or short name plus affiliation / specialty / credential-adjacency evidence. Measured true-positive retention 97.5-99.6% on 14,153 ground-truth pairs.

promoteEmptyRun.title: Overwrite Output even when the run found zero results
promoteEmptyRun.description: Safety default: a zero-result run leaves the previous Output untouched (an empty run usually signals an upstream failure).

serpConcurrency.title: SERP concurrency
serpConcurrency.description: Concurrent scraperlink Google-search runs shared across all KOLs (caps Apify account run usage). Effective concurrent runs = serpConcurrency, independent of kolConcurrency.

queriesPerRun.title: Queries per SERP run (batching)
queriesPerRun.description: Pack this many queries into ONE scraperlink run (deletes ~25s actor overhead per query). 6 = one run per KOL. Auto-falls back to per-query mode if the SERP actor rejects arrays.

queryClusters.title: Query clusters (subset)
queryClusters.description: Optional 1-based cluster subset. Empty = all six (no-miss default). Weekly-lean example [1,3,4,6]: broad+conference+press+events, skipping quotes and publications lanes when dedicated pubs/trials pipelines already run.
